messages:
Jonathan: Heads up — our monthly committed GPU usage report came back and the cost allocation looks off. Several Dedicated pools show up as 'unlabeled' in the billing export. Anyone know if tagging rules changed?
Mira: Not on my side. We rely on terraform tags + a post-provisioning lambda to apply team labels.
Alex: I saw the same in the console last week. New ephemeral pools created by the autoscaler didn't get the required `cost.center` tag.
Priya: Autoscaler should inherit tags from the instance template. I will check the launch config. Could be a race where the template is replaced without tags. :thinking_face:
Jonathan: The immediate impact: reserved capacity commitments (monthly) are getting attributed to the org-level bucket instead of product teams — finance is asking for a chargeback run.
finance-bot: @finance reported: "Estimated misallocation: $120k this month. Need tag-corrected export by EOD Fri to reconcile."
Mira: Quick triage plan: 1) Identify pools with missing tags via billing export 2) Backfill resources where possible 3) Block new unlabeled pools via admission policy
Alex: Query to list unlabeled resources (GCP example):
```
gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels.cost-center=" --format="table(name,labels)"
```
Jonathan: Also check reserved instance mapping — if AWS Reserved Instances / Savings Plans are attached, tag propagation behaves differently. We had an edge case where platform-owned RIs were applied to labeled instances but billed to the shared account.
Priya: For Preventive: we should add a Kubernetes admission controller that rejects nodepool/provisioner creation without `cost_center` and `product` labels. I can prototype a webhook.
Mira: Ops question — can we retroactively map past usage to teams if we can match instance IDs? Finance needs a best-effort allocation script for the last 3 months.
Alex: Yes — billing export + resource inventory join is the approach. I can run a daily job to join `gke_instance_id` -> `nodepool` -> `label` and emit a corrected CSV. Will take ~2 days to run and validate.
Jonathan: Long-term ask from finance: split commitments across teams based on steady-state consumption, not per-instance. We should propose a committed capacity allocation model (base % + usage-weighted).
Priya: Proposal sketch: each commitment pool is tagged with `commitment_owner` and `commitment_split: teamA=60,teamB=40` metadata. Billing pipeline will expand the split into per-team rows when generating chargeback.
Mira: Implementation notes: 1) extend billing ETL to support `commitment_split` parsing 2) add UI in Console for owners to set splits 3) enforce that pools with commitments must have an owner tag.
finance-bot: @finance requested fields: `cost_center`, `product`, `commitment_owner`, `commitment_split`, `environment` in the export.
Alex: I'll add a nightly reconciliation job that emits two artifacts: corrected cost.csv and a diff report for finance.
Jonathan: Operational guardrail: until we fix tagging, put a policy to deny creation of new reserved pools without `commitment_owner` + `cost_center`. Also run an immediate backfill for unlabeled resources this morning.
Priya: I'll open a PR to add the admission controller + chart and a runbook for oncall.
Mira: I'll start the backfill script now and attach logs here. If anyone sees weird attribution in dashboards, ping me.
Alex: Dropping the initial join query in case it helps:
```
SELECT invoice_month, resource_id, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing_export
LEFT JOIN resource_inventory USING(resource_id)
WHERE resource_inventory.labels.cost_center IS NULL
GROUP BY invoice_month, resource_id
```
Jonathan: Thanks all. Can we sync 1:1 with finance at 4pm? They want the reconciliation approach before weekend.
Priya: 4pm works. I'll bring the PR link and the admission controller demo.
Mira: Backfill job started — first batch done (50/430 nodes). Will post progress updates. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0452 - billing tag misallocation. Priority: P2. Assignee: Mira.
finance-bot: Reminder: please include the corrected CSV and the mapping logic in the ticket for auditors.
Jonathan: Great. Follow-ups: Mira/Alex run the backfill + reconciliation. Priya do admission controller PR. I'll draft the commitment-split proposal and loop in product owners.
